summary: ParseOptions silently accepted unknown --options; a --data typo could degrade the migration silently instead of a usage error.
resolution: Fixed: ParseOptions rejects unknown switches (ArgumentException -> exit 1) via an allowed value/flag set; added regression test.

summary: Broad InvalidDataException catch always reported classification invalid, misattributing IR/CSV failures.
Scoped classification read was moved outside the command-level try/catch, leaving non-InvalidData read failures uncaught.
resolution: Fixed: classification read moved back inside the main try with a tight nested InvalidDataException catch; other failures flow to the command-level handlers. R3 VERIFIED.
